description: This file defines the 'EmployeeDistributionBySubunitAPI' class, which provides an API endpoint to retrieve employee distribution data by subunit in the OrangeHRM dashboard. It includes methods for getting data, validation rules, and manages API response formatting. The class also uses traits and imports for external services and models.

classes.name: EmployeeDistributionBySubunitAPI
classes.description: API class providing endpoint to fetch employee distribution by subunit, extending core Endpoint and implementing CollectionEndpoint.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves the employee distribution by subunit data and returns it as an EndpointCollectionResult.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the GET request; currently returns empty rules.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Throws a 'not implemented' exception; creation functionality not supported.

methods.description: Throws exception; no validation for create operation.

methods.description: Throws exception; no validation for delete operation.
